name: Nagyhuta (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over pale yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagyhuta: a quartered shield of green and blue with trees, a mushroom, a figure and a beehive, within a wreath of oak, above a scroll inscribed NAGYHUTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagyhuta arms with oak wreath and scroll
